name: AotterTrekSDK
summary: AotterTrek iOS SDK: native ads, banners and Native Multimedia Ads with OM SDK measurement.
description:
The AotterTrek iOS SDK renders AotterTrek native ads, banners and Native Multimedia Ads (image, HTML5, WebView and
VAST video) and measures them with the IAB Open Measurement SDK. The shipped module is pure Objective-C and imports
from both Objective-C and Swift. Mediation adapters for Google Mobile Ads and AppLovin MAX live in the separate
AotterTrekMediation pod.
